# Alwin Rajkumar

> Personal portfolio of Alwin Rajkumar, a Computer Science & Engineering student and AI researcher at the University of Louisville. The site covers research in computer vision, generative AI, drone perception, and selected software projects.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://alwnraj.github.io/): Portfolio overview, biography, research, publications, and projects.
- [Structured portfolio page](https://alwnraj.github.io/for-llms.html): A concise, machine-readable summary of the portfolio.
- [Resume](https://alwnraj.github.io/Resume.pdf): Resume and academic background.

## Research and publications

- [First-Year Engineering Students' Expertise and Trust in GenAI](https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=view_citation&hl=en&user=WreVjDMAAAAJ&citation_for_view=WreVjDMAAAAJ:u5HHmVD_uO8C): Publication record on Google Scholar.
- [The Impact of a GenAI Integration on First-Year Engineering Students' Programming Outcomes](https://doi.org/10.1109/FIE63693.2025.11328708): Conference publication.
- [WIP — Evaluating GenAI Information Literacy from a Programming Documentation File](https://doi.org/10.1109/FIE63693.2025.11328245): Work-in-progress conference publication.
- [Crazyflie Figure-8 Flight with OptiTrack](https://github.com/alwnraj/AIMSLab-crazyflie): Motion-capture-guided autonomous Crazyflie flight research.

## Projects

- [Research Buddy](https://researchbuddy.pages.dev/): Desktop reader for chatting with academic PDFs; [source code](https://github.com/alwnraj/ResearchBuddy).
- [AI Flashcard Generator](https://flashcardgen.pages.dev/): Gemini-powered flashcard generator; [source code](https://github.com/alwnraj/flashcardgen).
- [AsmCalc](https://github.com/alwnraj/asmcalc): x86 assembly and C command-line calculator.
- [SmolMachine](https://alwnraj.github.io/smolmachine/): Browser-based image classification with MobileNet; [source code](https://github.com/alwnraj/smolmachine).
- [Chat App](https://github.com/alwnraj/chat-app): Real-time Python, Flask, and SocketIO chat application.
- [Pong](https://github.com/alwnraj/pong): Classic Pong built with Python and Pygame.
- [Space Invaders](https://github.com/alwnraj/Space-invaders): 2D retro Space Invaders built with C++ and Raylib.
- [MacMemory](https://github.com/alwnraj/macmemory): macOS menu-bar memory monitor.
